description: This file declares functions related to creating empty tensors with specific configurations in the ATen library of PyTorch. It defines functions like empty_mtia and empty_strided_mtia with various parameter options, presumably for tensor initialization.

methods.name: empty_mtia
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized tensor with given size, data type, device, and memory format options.

methods.name: empty_strided_mtia
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized tensor with given size, stride, data type, layout, device, and memory format options.
